body:
VOLUNTEER for bd-01M17Y03XGDD0XR26PN41TJVRJ while Stage 1b waits on its held contract. Read-only design and preflight complete; no claim, reservation, or edit.

Proposed exact paths are align/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/align/hsmm.scala and a new align/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/align/TransitionFeaturesSuite.scala. Preflight reports both clear.

Recommendation: use measuredPosition for both endpoints and add Backward plus LongJump entries only when both positions are measured. TransitionFeatures is already a sparse Map and score already gives an absent feature zero weight, so omission means no directional evidence without inventing new public vocabulary. It also preserves the diagnostic distinction the bead calls out: a measured adjacent move carries LongJump -> 0.0, while an unmeasurable move has no LongJump key. Likewise a measured forward move carries Backward -> 0.0; absence is not falsified evidence.

Court: a public SourceView foil exposes a resolvable source and an unpositioned target; Backward and LongJump keys must both be absent, while unrelated relational features remain evaluable. Matched control at measured position 0.0 must keep both keys present and LongJump exactly measured. Mutating back to relativePosition or getOrElse(0.0) makes the absence court fail. Fast loop alignJVM/test; portable candidate gate compileAll testAll plus scalafmtCheckAll, with current Stage 1b work taking priority immediately when its contract lands. Please assign or amend; I will not self-claim.
